root_session_controls.start_checks: python3 tools/ai/audit_root_session.py --start-check at session start and after account, environment or settings changes: claude auth status claude.ai/firstParty; no ANTHROPIC/OPENAI/CODEX/AWS/GOOGLE/GEMINI/AZURE/VERTEX API key or auth token env, no CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK/VERTEX/FOUNDRY or OPENAI_BASE_URL; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL absent or anthropic.com; project settings pins; deny list enforced; codex ChatGPT login; names/types only; stop inference on failure
root_session_controls.tool_restriction: root_denied_tools and root_denied_permissions enforced before execution through untracked .claude/settings.local.json permissions.deny (the legacy runner rejects extra keys in .claude/settings.json), which also allows mcp__unityMCP; deny wins over allow and applies in every permission mode; the PreToolUse merge-gate hook blocks force-push to main; only root_allowed_mcp_servers may be called; recreate the local file on another machine; plus repository hard rails
root_session_controls.unity_lock: acquire ops/ai/local/exclusive-control.lock through run_claude.acquire_lock with run_id claude-root-<session_id> before any Editor write, including computer-use clicks or typing in the Unity window; do not write if held; release only its own lock through run_claude.release_lock; a stale lock is removed only after checking the Editor
root_session_controls.codex_calls: only when codex login status is ChatGPT and no OpenAI/Codex API key or base URL env; reviews via codex exec -s read-only -m gpt-6.1-sol with explicit model_reasoning_effort
root_session_controls.audit: tools/ai/audit_root_session.py before each commit or acceptance (see root_session_audit); exit 1 blocks; acceptance records the root session_id, audit result, Unity lock events and Codex thread id/model/effort/exit; raw JSONL stays local
root_session_controls.permission_mode_tradeoff: the permission mode is the user's choice (default, acceptEdits, auto or bypassPermissions); in bypassPermissions other Bash commands run without a prompt, so prefix deny rules (bypassable by compound or indirect forms) and the retrospective audit are the only guards; default or acceptEdits, or an OS sandbox, is stronger; the audit records the mode

root_session_audit.start: python3 tools/ai/audit_root_session.py --start-check at session start and after any account, environment or settings change
root_session_audit.before_acceptance: python3 tools/ai/audit_root_session.py --out reports/<unit>/root_session_audit.json before each commit or acceptance of a unit
root_session_audit.blocking: exit 1 (violations, or no current passing ROOT_START_CHECK after the last settings/auth change) blocks commit and acceptance; shell input is parsed with shlex: only quoted-delimiter heredoc bodies are literal, unquoted heredoc bodies and quoted words are searched for $(...)/backtick substitutions, sh|bash|zsh -c, eval and shell heredocs are scanned recursively, and an unparsable input naming a sensitive program blocks; opaque code-execution tools and untargeted full-screen input block; subagent protected work (Unity writes, codex exec, git commit/push) blocks; lock and start-check events count only for the exact documented single plain command after its recorded result; --waive TOOL_USE_ID=REASON or KIND:DETAIL=REASON records an explained exception in the report and the acceptance record
root_session_audit.warnings: exposed-but-unused servers outside the allowlist, proxy env names and a lock still held; reviewed but not blocking
root_session_audit.limits: unverified and listed in every report: initial tool list, MCP subprocess environments, live inference environment versus the checked shell environment, interpreter code semantics (python -c, python heredocs, node -e), Usage credits/Extra usage OFF (account UI); acceptance records them as audit-unverified without blocking
root_session_audit.nature: bounded retrospective evidence against accidental policy breaks; not launch enforcement, not equivalent to the legacy runner's sanitized launch, and not proof against a session that sets out to evade it
